title: Birth in Versailles, Kentucky, parents and wife
summary: Jones gives his birth date and place, his parents' names, and talks about his wife Sinobie, who attended Simmons University, and their long marriage.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Well, Mr. Harvey Jones, let's go back. Jasper Taylor, I'll play it back in a minute, but as long as it's still running, I thought we'd pick up some of this stuff. Now, Jasper said you were born where? Versailles, Kentucky. They call it Versailles in France and they call it Versailles in Kentucky, huh?
Yeah. Uh, January 27, 1902. Is that right?
Henry. Uh, and you went to college, did you?
Oh, that, your wife went to college. All right. And she too was born in Versailles.
Uh, it was Simmons University that she went to. That's right. Um, now is this, uh, uh, your present wife?
Well, you were married previously though, huh? No. No? Gee, you stayed a bachelor a long time. Forty, forty-four years. Yeah, I married. Wow, good for you. I was six.
